vendored.name: the Rive runtime
vendored.comment: The Rive C++ runtime and the shaders generated from it, compiled into the window for the pet, at the commit desktop/rive/vendor/COMMIT names.

vendored.name: glad
vendored.comment: The EGL and OpenGL ES loaders glad 2.0.8 generated from the Khronos registry. glad offers what it generates under WTFPL or CC0-1.0, and this package takes it under CC0-1.0; the registry it is generated from is Apache-2.0.

vendored.name: khrplatform.h
vendored.comment: The Khronos platform header glad's loaders include.

vendored.name: eglplatform.h
vendored.comment: The Khronos EGL platform header glad's loaders include.
